# Vendored 1Password Connect OpenAPI specifications

Pin: **1.8.1**

Source: https://developer.1password.com/docs/connect/api-reference

These YAML files are vendored from the api-evangelist/1password mirror of the
Connect Server API specification. When 1Password publishes a newer Connect
spec, bump the pin in `docs/onepassword-compat/matrix.json` and update these
files in the same pull request.
